literature_notes: All three ledger lines (L1, L2, L3) describe tags placed at the native C-terminus of full-length ADAM19. The C-terminus (residue 955) lies in the intracellular domain (topology: IC 722–955). L2 explicitly labels this the 'cytoplasmic-domain.' No ledger line reports any tag insertion on the extracellular face (residues 26–702), at the mature N-terminus (after residue 25), or in any extracellular loop. Because the rules require every site to be grounded in a ledger line reporting a tolerated insertion on the extracellular surface, and no such line exists, zero sites qualify. The C-terminal position is recorded in other_positions as intracellular.

literature_other_positions.note: FLAG tag fused to the native C-terminus of full-length ADAM19; residue 955 (A) is the last residue of the intracellular domain (IC: 722–955), confirmed intracellular by topology landmarks.
